signals.text: 3 open PM roles across 1 US office

bullets: Define and own product strategy, roadmap, and feature priorities, balancing customer needs, technical feasibility, and business objectives.
Gather and analyze customer feedback, product data, and market insights to identify opportunities and prioritize solutions that deliver measurable value.
Partner closely with engineering teams to define technical requirements, evaluate architecture and design tradeoffs, and deliver scalable, reliable software products.
Lead the full product lifecycle, from discovery and technical definition through development, launch, adoption, and ongoing optimization.
Support go-to-market activities, including product positioning, pricing and packaging recommendations, sales enablement, and launch planning.

roles.title: Principal Product Manager, APIs, MCP & Developer Platform

bullets: Own the API layer that makes Storable’s products work as one platform: one consistent way to reach tenants, units, leases and payments, whichever product they live in.
Define the shared resource model behind it with engineering and product teams: common entities, IDs and behavior across products.
Own Storable’s MCP server and make it secure from day one: authenticated access, scoped permissions, tenant isolation, audit trails and protection against misuse, on the same…
Set the standards every Storable interface follows: authentication and permissions, errors, versioning, pagination, rate limits, documentation and deprecation. Product teams…
Decide which products and capabilities come onto the platform first, based on what operators, partners and our own agents need most.

roles.title: Principal Product Manager, AI Agents & Automation

bullets: Own the agents that serve prospects and tenants across voice and text, and the automations that take routine work off facility staff, from request to completion.
Choose which workflows agents take on first, and which come next across Storable’s products as model capabilities improve, working with Operations and Support.
Set the rules for every action: what agents may do, what needs verification, confirmation or staff approval, and when to hand off to a person. Work with Legal and Compliance where…
Define what operators can configure themselves, including knowledge, policies, escalation rules and brand voice, so agents work for a single facility or a large portfolio without…
Define what good looks like for each workflow: success criteria, agent evaluations, quality thresholds and launch gates, tracked in production.
